2103-4423-6886-8344.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
2103-4423-6886-8344.notablePrerequisites: Nog's second activated ability has been activated.
2103-4423-6886-8344.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou during your draw step.
Repeat.

1418-1651-6754-6756-8344.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1418-1651-6754-6756-8344.notablePrerequisites:
Nog's second activated ability has been activated.
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1418-1651-6754-6756-8344.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers twice due to Virtue of Knowledge, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

643-3510-3875-8168.easyPrerequisites: You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
643-3510-3875-8168.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each permanent that entered is a Saproling through Maskwood Nexus and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Provisioner to trigger.
Resolve a Tireless Provisioner trigger, replacing the artifact token creation with that many 5/5 Dragons through Draconic Visitor.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

301-3899-5643.easyPrerequisites: You have had at least one Zombie enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
301-3899-5643.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your cotnrol this turn.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

1479-5478-5700-5701-7885.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5478-5700-5701-7885.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Down in the Valley trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Down in the Valley trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Down in the Valley triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Down in the Valley trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Down in the Valley triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
1479-5478-5700-5701-7885.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

2034-5003-7805.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Captain James T. Kirk, adding {C}{C}.
When Captain James T. Kirk dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Captain James T. Kirk from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Captain James T. Kirk enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-5003-7805.notes: If you have no cards in hand, you can choose both Captain James T. Kirk's second and third modes.

1895-2781-6626-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-7297-7686.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
An opponent cannot block and kill The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl.
3259-7297-7686.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl as attackers.
The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2921-7124-7357.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
2921-7124-7357.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Pugnacious Pugilist as attackers.
Pugnacious Pugilist triggers, creating a 1/1 Devil creature token.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Devil.
When the Devil dies, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat each combat phase.

requires.n: Land with Cycling Cost that can be paid using one colored mana

65-2546-2628-7330--38.description:
Activate the land's cycling ability by paying {0} due to Fluctuator and discarding it.
When you cycle the land, Escape Protocol and Surly Badgersaur trigger.
Resolve Surly Badgersaur's ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding (1).
Resolve Escape Protocol's ability, paying {1} to blink Mikey & Mona.
When Mikey & Mona enters, it triggers, returning the cycled land from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1, drawing a card.
Repeat
65-2546-2628-7330--38.notes: Since you can draw your entire library, discarding down to maximum hand size at end of turn will trigger Surly Badgersaur's abilities many times.

443-3967-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
443-3967-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Magus of the Bridge and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1494-3716-4613-7152.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Thing.
1494-3716-4613-7152.description:
Cast Fanning the Flames with buyback by paying {3}{R}{R}, returning it to your hand.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Thing's first ability triggers, putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Declare The Thing as an attacker. Its second ability triggers, causing you to pay {R}{G}{W}{U} to double the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate The Thing using Sage of Hours' ability by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
1494-3716-4613-7152.notes: You can cast any noncreature spell in lieu of Fanning the Flames. Fanning the Flames is strongly recommended as it guarantees you can cast a noncreature spell each turn, but you may omit it at your discretion.

1876-2557-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
1876-2557-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Nissa, Worldwaker
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

413-4027-4986--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Glint Hawk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Glint Hawk enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Glint Hawk trigger, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Glint Hawk.
Repeat.
413-4027-4986--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

1369-5457-7086.easyPrerequisites: Quicksilver Elemental does not have summoning sickness.
1369-5457-7086.description:
Cast Touch of Vitae by paying {2}{G}, targeting Selvala.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {U}, causing it to gain Selvala's activated abilities until end of turn.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Selvala's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Selvala's ability granted to it by Touch of Vitae by paying {0}, untapping Quicksilver Elemental.
Repeat from step 2.

2510-4943-7070.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-4943-7070.description:
Activate Lancers en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Lancers en-Kor.
The Lancers en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Lancers en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Semblance Anvil.
Repeat.

1978-2392-3443.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three creature cards in your graveyard.
1978-2392-3443.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Deathbloom Ritualist.
Repeat

3525-4289-6936.description:
Activate Goblin Medics by tapping it, adding {U}.
Goblin Medics triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Goblin Medics.
Repeat.

1987-4002-4423-6918.easyPrerequisites:
You control three or more lands that share a name.
You control three additional Islands.
1987-4002-4423-6918.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping them, adding {U} and three mana of any color.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

323-1497-2173-5220.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1308-4231-4321-5777.description:
Activate Camellia by paying {2} and sacrificing a Food.
Camellia's first ability triggers, creating two Foods, two Clues, two Treasures and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Resolve the Camellia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Squirrel you control.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.
1308-4231-4321-5777.notes: You can replace step 1 with using the Food's own ability to sacrifice it.

1365-2511-2608-6582.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Derevi and Aerith persist until end of turn.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Derevi.
When Derevi dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Aerith.
When Aerith dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve Aerith's persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the second Aerith trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each legendary creature you control, thus removing the -1/-1 counters from Aerith and Derevi.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from steps 2 and 5.
Repeat.
1365-2511-2608-6582.notes: The combo does not put +1/+1 counters on Derevi or Aerith, but does on any other legendary creature(s) you control.

1117-3689-4985-6518.description:
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

856-4050-4321-6462.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4050-4321-6462.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Kheru Goldkeeper trigger.
Resolve the Kheru Goldkeeper trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

2079-2105-3204-6188.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
2079-2105-3204-6188.description:
Declare either Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1309-1987-2239-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1309-1987-2239-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Salvager of Secrets and Ardent Elementalist.
When Salvager of Secrets and Ardent Elementalist enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1309-1987-2239-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

38-647-659.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of Goblins that is equal to or greater than six plus Krenko's commander tax.
38-647-659.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Goblin creature tokens equal to the number of Goblins you control.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Krenko, adding {R}.
Choose to return Krenko to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Krenko.
Cast Krenko from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{R} plus commander tax.
Repeat.

uses.n: Storm the Vault // Vault of Catlacan

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

478-804-1460-2821-3301.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four artifacts.
478-804-1460-2821-3301.description:
Animate Candelabra using Tezzeret
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U}. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Vault of Catlacan by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Vault of Catlacan.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

372-864-3556.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Flicker exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Eternal Witness exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Flicker.
372-864-3556.description:
Cast Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Eternal Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Eternal Witness trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Flicker.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Eternal Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

914-4863-5530.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-4863-5530.description:
Cast Another Round by paying {2}{W}, blinking Dockside Extortionist and Revolutionist.
When Dockside Extortionist and Revolutionist enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.
914-4863-5530.notes: If opponents control four or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

1238-2351-2511-4452-5467.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

4826-5411-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
4826-5411-5720-5721.description:
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

2919-4476-5641.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
2919-4476-5641.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

624-1621.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Phantasmal Image.
624-1621.description:
Cast Phantasmal Image by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Phantasmal Image enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Phantasmal Image. Choose to have Phantasmal Image enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

1432-1648-2821-3201.notablePrerequisites:
Ioreth of the Healing House does not have summoning sickness.
Arixmethes is a creature and does not have summoning sickness.
1432-1648-2821-3201.description:
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Minamo to become a 3/3 Elemental creature with menace and haste that's still a land until end of turn.
Activate Arixmethes by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House's second ability by tapping it, untapping Minamo and Arixmethes.
Repeat from step 2.

85-1284-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Viridian Longbow and Thornbite Staff attached to a creature with deathtouch.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
85-1284-2178.description:
Activate the creature's ability from Viridian Longbow by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target creature an opponent controls and destroying that target due to deathtouch.
When that target dies, the creature's ability from Thornbite Staff triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1409-2034-3263-3895.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Diregraf Horde.
1409-2034-3263-3895.description:
Activate Diregraf Horde by paying {2}, blinking it.
When Diregraf Horde enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Diregraf Horde.
Resolve the Diregraf Horde trigger, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Zombie, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

890-1978-2410-3714.notablePrerequisites: Myr Galvanizer, Palladium Myr and Copper Myr do not have summoning sickness.
890-1978-2410-3714.description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Copper Myr by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Myr Galvanizer.
Activate Myr Galvanizer by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping each other Myr you control.
Repeat.

2902-5299.description:
Cast Journey to Nowhere by paying {1}{W}.
Journey to Nowhere enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling itself.
Journey to Nowhere leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning itself from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

729-2529-3593.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{U}{R}.
Vedalkan Mastermind does not have summoning sickness.
729-2529-3593.description:
Activate all mana producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}{R}.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Great Oak Guardian from your hand onto the battlefield.
Great Oak Guardian enters the battlefield, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Vedalken Mastermind by paying {U} and tapping it, returning Great Oak Guardian from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1642-3354.notablePrerequisites:
Raving Dead does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents have even life totals.
Opponents are unable to block and kill Raving Dead.
Warlock Class is level three.
1642-3354.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Raving Dead.
Raving Dead triggers, causing the opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Warlock Class triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1003-2034-3249.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Phyrexian Walker.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization
